name: Drifting Ice
description: Ice floes on open water that drift and turn on a slow current and bump into each other; the pointer pushes them aside and a click cracks one.

props.name: count
props.description: Roughly how many floes are in view at once. Floes are sized so that together they cover `coverage` of the frame.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the current. 0 leaves the floes resting until the pointer moves them.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the floe shapes, their placement and the current. The same seed gives the same ice.

props.name: coverage
props.description: Share of the water covered by ice, from 0.05 to 0.7. Four tenths is 0.4.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Let the pointer push floes aside, leaving a wake, and let a click crack the floe under it into two or three pieces. Clicks on links, buttons and fields stay with them.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the ice. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the ice. Mark a descendant with `data-ice-clear` to keep floes drifting around it, so text there always sits over open water.
